notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima the Impostor is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Sakashima the Impostor do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by tapping it.
When Sakashima the Impostor becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Sakashima the Impostor's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
